language-model-taxonomy.scope: Representative architecture families and model-system patterns known through 2025.
language-model-taxonomy.notice: This is not a list of 2,000–2,500 individual models. Future possibilities through 2500 are speculative, not established knowledge.

model.name: Statistical language model
model.description: Predicts tokens from local frequency context; useful baseline, limited long-range structure.

model.name: Probabilistic sequence model
model.description: Models hidden states and observed token sequences; historically important for speech and NLP.

model.name: Structured prediction
model.description: Labels sequences using contextual feature dependencies in classical NLP pipelines.

model.name: Neural language model
model.description: Predicts a token from a fixed context window using dense neural layers.

model.name: Recurrent neural network
model.description: Processes sequences with recurrent state; foundational neural sequence architecture.

model.name: Gated recurrent network
model.description: Uses input, forget, and output gates to retain information over longer sequences.

model.name: Gated recurrent network
model.description: A streamlined gated recurrent architecture with update and reset gates.

model.name: Encoder-decoder sequence model
model.description: Maps an input sequence to an output sequence, often with recurrent or transformer components.

model.name: Attention-based encoder-decoder
model.description: Allows decoder steps to focus on relevant encoded input positions.

model.name: Bidirectional encoder
model.description: Uses self-attention and feed-forward blocks for contextual representations; BERT-style family.

model.name: Autoregressive decoder
model.description: Uses causal self-attention to predict the next token; GPT-style family.

model.name: Text-to-text transformer
model.description: Uses an encoder and autoregressive decoder for translation, summarization, and general text tasks.

model.name: Conditional-compute model
model.description: Routes tokens or examples to a subset of expert networks to scale capacity with conditional computation.

model.name: Retrieval-grounded model system
model.description: Combines a language model with search or document retrieval; retrieved evidence is distinct from model weights.

model.name: Extended-context model
model.description: Uses attention variants, memory, or position strategies to process longer sequences.

model.name: State-space sequence model
model.description: Uses structured state-space dynamics or selective scans as an alternative to full attention in some settings.
